text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: My story that I wrote, Victor Wembanyama is slated to be the projected winner of the defensive player of the year.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: There is one stat that will determine that: did he play 65 games or not?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is the projected MVP winner by ESPN's panel
quotes.excerpt: The projected MVP by ESPN's never wrong panel is Victor Wembanyama

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The projected MVP by ESPN's never wrong panel is Victor Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Is that who you voted for?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is the clear front-runner for MVP
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama was the clear-cut front runner, 102 points in the voting

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Wembanyama was the clear-cut front runner, 102 points in the voting. And then two through four, you have Jokic at 31 points, Luka at 28 points, and Shai at 26 points. What you are basically saying is there is a clear front runner and then three guys that we anticipate will be in the mix, and then there is a significant drop off. Giannis is fifth at eight points.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: To me, that is right. There are four bonafide real-deal MVP candidates and Wembanyama is the clear-cut front runner of that four.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic is in great shape for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Luka is as lean as he's been since his rookie year

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Luka is as lean as he's been since his rookie year. If you look at some of the footage that came out of the Slovenian trip that he organized and funded for that whole team, dude, he looks like he is in great shape.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He was able to do that last year and so the question is can he commit to it?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Joksimovic is a promising 17-year-old prospect
quotes.excerpt: There is a 17-year-old, Stefan Joksimovic, who is right about to turn 18
quotes.quote: There is a 17-year-old, Stefan Joksimovic, who is right about to turn 18. He was the MVP of the EuroBasket U18, which was in Italy a couple of weeks ago. He averaged 23 points, seven rebounds, and four assists a game. Remember those are 40-minute games. He is going to be draft-eligible next year and I believe will be a high lottery pick.
